questions.question: Why did Paul want the Thessalonian believers to understand what happens to Christians who have died?

answers.text: So they would not grieve like people without hope
So they could honor their memory every year
So they would know where each one is buried

questions.question: When the Lord comes down from heaven, what will sound along with a loud command and an archangel's voice?
In his letter to the Thessalonians, how did Paul say the Day of the Lord will come?

answers.text: Like a thief in the night
Like a sunrise after a long night
Like a king with a long parade

questions.question: Paul told the Thessalonian believers that God has appointed them to suffer wrath. True or false?
